lines.text: The Philistines fight Israel, and the Philistines kill Saul's sons and wound Saul with archers on Mount Gilboa.
Saul's armor-bearer refuses to kill him, so Saul falls on his own sword, and the armor-bearer then does the same.
The Philistines strip Saul, take his armor, and hang his head in the temple of Baal.
The men of Jabesh-gilead bury the bones of Saul and his sons under the oak and fast twelve days.
Saul dies for his unfaithfulness, and the LORD turns the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.
